source.inspectionScope: Full substantive actual diff and commit message read. Incidental formatter changes in build-recovery patches are not treated as style evidence.

commit ff1382d5fba4c8971442a1df7c25e139d360510e
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Oct 30 11:07:46 2024 +1300
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Wed Oct 30 11:07:46 2024 +1300

    Bug 1927940 - Stop enabling MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC outside the nightly build. r=rjl
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D227281

diff --git a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
index 9c59b363a75..c2af4a331fc 100644
--- a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
+++ b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
@@ -1354,12 +1354,9 @@ pref("identity.fxaccounts.oauth.enabled", false);
 pref("identity.fxaccounts.remote.profile.uri", "https://profile.stage.mozaws.net/v1");
 // The remote URL of the FxA OAuth Server
 pref("identity.fxaccounts.remote.oauth.uri", "https://oauth.stage.mozaws.net/v1");
-#endif
 // Token server used by the FxA Sync identity.
-// This pref exists on all channels to keep a test working.
 pref("identity.sync.tokenserver.uri", "https://token.stage.mozaws.net/1.0/sync/1.5");
 
-#ifdef NIGHTLY_BUILD
 // Adds Firefox/10x.0 to the User-Agent string, because we need it.
 // TODO: Fix this.
 pref("general.useragent.compatMode.firefox", true);
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index b485f37d4be..52c2068bad3 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -12,7 +12,13 @@ set_config("MOZ_APPUPDATE_HOST", "aus.thunderbird.net")
 
 imply_option("--enable-default-browser-agent", False)
 imply_option("MOZ_REQUIRE_SIGNING", False)
-imply_option("MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC", True)
+
+@depends(milestone)
+def enable_sync(milestone):
+    return milestone.is_nightly
+
+imply_option("MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC", True, when=enable_sync)
+
 imply_option("NSS_EXTRA_SYMBOLS_FILE", "../comm/mailnews/nss-extra.symbols")
 
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_ID", "{3550f703-e582-4d05-9a08-453d09bdfdc6}")
title: History 1163: Bug 1927940 - Stop enabling MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC outside the nightly build. r=rjl
